budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Contain two spreading fire fronts while preserving at least one of three shared assets, using finite water, temporary firebreaks and teammate transfers.
task.natural_termination: Success when all fire lifetimes are zero and at least one asset survives; failure when all three assets have zero integrity. The shared per-step reward is success minus failure minus total new asset damage divided by 16. Otherwise truncate at step 96.
task.interaction: Building blocks partners' movement and fire transmission at the same physical cells. Using the depot consumes finite supplies available to others. Handing water to an adjacent teammate enables later suppression or construction. Firebreak erosion and depleted fuel determine future spread.
task.observation_access: The entire physical world and resource state are public. All groups have all-true role visibility and the static terrain is public. Observation includes the complete fire, fuel and barrier arrays, all worker resources and all protected assets.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Indices 0 to 6: spray used, firebreak built, water transferred, firebreak dismantled, asset damaged, success, failure; flags refer to the most recent nonterminal transition.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
